2608.04949.title: UG-UMRE: Uncertainty-Guided Modality Augmentation and Distributional Calibration for Unified Multimodal Relation Extraction
2608.04949.paper_summary: Unified Multimodal Relation Extraction (UMRE) aims to identify intra-modal and cross-modal relations between textual entities and visual objects. However, existing UMRE studies still encounter two critical issues: ignoring inherent aleatoric uncertainty causes noise propagation, and deep-seated heterogeneity between distinct modal distributions hinders alignment. To address these issues, we propose the Uncertainty-Guided UMRE Network (UG-UMRE). Specifically, we design an Uncertainty-Driven Unimodal Augmentation (UDUA) module, which models features as Gaussian distributions based on the Variational Information Bottleneck. By incorporating an uncertainty-aware self-supervised contrastive learning mechanism, UDUA effectively filters out noise while maintaining semantic consistency. Furthermore, we introduce the Joint Aleatoric Uncertainty Alignment (JAUA) module as a global semantic pre-calibration mechanism. JAUA leverages probabilistic distribution consistency to construct a shared latent space, eliminating the distributional gap by synchronizing cross-modal statistical properties, thereby laying a robust foundation for fine-grained interaction. Experiments on three benchmark datasets (UMRE, MORE, and MNRE) demonstrate that UG-UMRE achieves state-of-the-art performance. Further analysis validates the pluggable and effective performance of the proposed UDUA and JAUA modules.
2608.04949.paper_summary_zh: 統一多模態關係提取（UMRE）旨在識別文本實體與視覺物體之間的內部模態和跨模態關係。<lb/>然而，現有的UMRE研究仍然面臨兩個關鍵問題：忽略固有的隨機不確定性導致噪聲傳播，以及不同模態分佈之間根深蒂固的異質性妨礙對齊。<lb/>為了解決這些問題，我們提出了不確定性引導的UMRE網絡（UG-UMRE）。<lb/>具體而言，我們設計了一個不確定性驅動的單模態增強（UDUA）模塊，該模塊基於變分信息瓶頸將特徵建模為高斯分佈。<lb/>通過結合不確定性感知的自我監督對比學習機制，UDUA有效地過濾掉噪聲，同時保持語義一致性。<lb/>此外，我們引入了聯合隨機不確定性對齊（JAUA）模塊，作為一種全局語義預校準機制。<lb/>JAUA利用概率分佈一致性構建共享潛在空間，通過同步跨模態統計特性消除分佈差距，從而為細粒度交互奠定堅實基礎。<lb/>在三個基準數據集（UMRE、MORE和MNRE）上的實驗表明，UG-UMRE達到了最先進的性能。<lb/>進一步的分析驗證了所提出的UDUA和JAUA模塊的可插拔性和有效性。
